item.title: Air Routes, Security and Services Shift
item.description: New transport links, security fixes and practical service changes lead this briefing.
item.content:encoded:
New transport links, security fixes and practical service changes lead this briefing.

  1. FortiMail zero-day is being actively exploited Fortinet warned that attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-104286 in FortiMail; administrators running affected systems have a concrete patching and exposure-check decision. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  2. Regional Australia loses Network 10 terrestrial broadcasts WIN confirmed Network 10, 10 Drama and 10 Comedy will stop free-to-air transmission in Mount Gambier, the Riverland and Griffith after 9 October; online access remains. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  3. Western Sydney International prepares for October passenger opening Sydney’s new A$5.6 billion Western Sydney International Airport is set to begin passenger operations this month, adding a second major international gateway for the city. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  4. Finnair adds a new Melbourne-Europe option via Bangkok Finnair will begin daily Helsinki–Melbourne A350 service via Bangkok on 25 October, adding another one-stop Australia–Europe option and fifth-freedom service between Bangkok and Melbourne. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  5. Ilulissat becomes a direct international gateway Greenland’s new Ilulissat international airport opens 29 October with a direct Copenhagen inaugural flight, followed by regular winter service, materially simplifying access to Disko Bay. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  6. Emirates starts year-round Dubai–Helsinki flights Emirates launched daily Dubai–Helsinki A350 service on 1 October, creating the only year-round nonstop link between Finland and the UAE and another connection option through Dubai. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  7. Airlink opens the first Cape Town–Zanzibar nonstop Airlink began weekly direct Cape Town–Zanzibar flights on 3 October using an E195-E2, creating a new nonstop leisure route across the Indian Ocean. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  8. Breeze restores Tampa–Costa Rica nonstop service Breeze began twice-weekly Tampa–San José flights on 3 October, restoring a nonstop city pair absent for more than 25 years. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  9. India puts its first LNG-assisted train into service Indian Railways launched its first LNG dual-fuel train; LNG can replace up to 40% of diesel use and the train can run up to about 1,600 km without refuelling. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  10. ServiceNow launches a midmarket AI service desk ServiceNow launched Flow, an AI-native service desk aimed at midmarket organisations that can be deployed through Slack or Teams, creating a lighter alternative to its enterprise service-management stack. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  11. ShinyHunters-linked hacker detained in Jordan A hacker linked to the ShinyHunters group has been detained in Jordan and is reportedly cooperating with investigators, a concrete change in a campaign associated with major corporate data theft. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  12. Genesis vehicles recalled over fuel-leak fire risk A new recall covers multiple 2023–2025 Genesis GV70, GV80, G80 and G90 vehicles because a fuel leak can increase fire risk. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  13. Kia Carnival vehicles recalled over fuel-leak fire risk A new recall covers 2023–2025 Kia Carnival vehicles because a fuel leak can increase fire risk. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  14. Australia’s major banks pass through the latest RBA rise Australia’s big four banks announced variable mortgage-rate increases after the Reserve Bank lifted the cash rate, raising borrowing costs for households considering a move or property purchase. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  15. Global manufacturing expands with semiconductor and AI demand September factory surveys showed expansion across much of Europe and Asia, including South Korea’s fastest export growth in more than 15 years and Taiwan PMI at 56.7. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  16. US AI companies sign a voluntary safeguards agreement Major AI companies joined a White House voluntary safeguards agreement covering internal controls and third-party audits; the agreement has no statutory penalties for non-compliance. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  17. Australia’s regional free-TV choice contracts further The confirmed 9 October Network 10 shutdown means affected regional viewers using aerial television will retain other networks but need internet delivery for Network 10 programming. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  18. New Zealand climate series records a 1.36°C long-run rise New Stats NZ climate data reports New Zealand’s average annual temperature has risen 1.36°C since 1909, updating the official measurement series used for infrastructure and climate-risk decisions. 04 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
